title: A photorealistic cinematic vertical full
prompt:
A photorealistic cinematic vertical full-body mirror-selfie portrait of a young adult woman in her early twenties, around 20 years old, standing casually in a minimalist modern bedroom or dressing area. Her specific ethnicity or race cannot be reliably determined from appearance alone and should not be inferred solely from the photograph. She has smooth fair-to-light skin with a warm natural undertone, a softly rounded youthful face, dark brown eyes partly visible around the smartphone, natural straight eyebrows, a small-to-medium refined nose, and softly full pink lips. Her expression is calm, neutral, and slightly relaxed, with her gaze directed toward the phone screen while taking the mirror selfie.

Her hair is long, thick, and very dark brown to nearly black, falling several inches below her shoulders in naturally loose, slightly tousled waves. She has full wispy straight bangs across her forehead and soft face-framing strands along both cheeks. Her physique is feminine and naturally curvy, with a defined waist, fuller hips and thighs, proportional shoulders, and strong softly rounded legs.

She stands almost front-facing toward a large floor-length mirror, feet spaced slightly apart and knees relaxed. Her right arm is raised in front of her face holding a light silver-gray smartphone vertically, partially obscuring the center of her face. Her left elbow is bent outward as her left hand lightly gathers or touches a section of hair beside her shoulder. A black rectangular smartwatch is worn on her left wrist.

She is wearing exactly a coordinated gray athletic lounge set: a fitted medium-gray cropped sports bra with broad shoulder straps, a scoop neckline, and a wide ribbed elastic underband, exposing her midriff and navel; paired with matching high-waisted gray fitted short shorts featuring a gathered elastic waistband and a centered white-gray drawstring tied loosely at the front. She wears plain off-white crew-length socks reaching above the ankles, with no shoes and no additional garments.

The environment is simple and uncluttered: warm beige wall behind her, glossy light beige tiled flooring, dark brown baseboard, a partially visible open dark doorway on the right, warm wooden door or wardrobe panel along the frame edge, and the white border of the mirror visible on the left. Soft diffused daylight illuminates the room from outside the frame, creating gentle natural shadows and realistic skin highlights. Shot with a smartphone-like 26–28mm equivalent lens, eye-level mirror perspective, subtle optical softness, realistic indoor exposure, muted warm-neutral color grading, low contrast, natural skin texture, candid lifestyle photography, no dramatic retouching, 9:16.
